title: PI-Hunter: Automated Red-Teaming for Exposing and Localizing Prompt Injections
title_zh: PI-Hunter：用于暴露与定位 Prompt Injection 的自动化 Red-Teaming 框架
abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are rapidly evolving into agentic systems that interact with external tools and environments, introducing new security risks such as indirect prompt injection attacks through untrusted external sources. Existing defenses mainly focus on blocking malicious content at inference time, and current red-teaming methods primarily optimize attack success. As a result, developers have limited visibility into how latent prompt injections emerge and propagate through agents. We propose PI-Hunter, an automated agentic auditing framework for proactive vulnerability exposure in LLM agents. PI-Hunter constructs realistic source-aware test cases and iteratively evolves them through feedback-driven exploration to induce agents to retrieve and reveal latent malicious instructions embedded within external environments. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks, agent architectures, attacks, and defenses demonstrate that PI-Hunter substantially improves vulnerability exposure and attack-surface coverage over strong automated red-teaming baselines, while remaining effective under existing prompt injection defenses.
abstract_zh: 随着 Large Language Models (LLMs) 快速演化为可与外部工具和环境交互的 agentic systems，来自不可信外部来源的 indirect prompt injection 等安全风险日益突出。现有防御多聚焦于推理阶段拦截恶意内容，而当前 red-teaming 方法主要优化攻击成功率，导致开发者难以观察潜在 prompt injections 如何在 agents 中出现并传播。本文提出 PI-Hunter，一个用于主动暴露 LLM agents 漏洞的自动化 agentic auditing 框架。PI-Hunter 构造具有真实来源感知（source-aware）的测试用例，并通过反馈驱动的探索迭代演化这些用例，诱导 agents 检索并泄露嵌入外部环境中的潜在恶意指令。跨多个 benchmarks、agent architectures、attacks 与 defenses 的实验表明，相比强自动化 red-teaming baselines，PI-Hunter 显著提升了漏洞暴露能力与攻击面覆盖率，并且在现有 prompt injection defenses 下仍保持有效。
key_points_zh: 提出 PI-Hunter，用于对 LLM agents 进行主动式、自动化 red-teaming 与安全审计。
通过构造 source-aware 测试用例，模拟外部环境中潜伏的 indirect prompt injection 风险。
采用反馈驱动探索机制迭代优化测试样本，诱导 agent 检索、传播并暴露隐藏恶意指令。
实验覆盖多个 benchmarks、agent architectures、attacks 和 defenses，显示其漏洞暴露与攻击面覆盖优于强基线。
即使面对现有 prompt injection defenses，PI-Hunter 仍能有效发现潜在安全问题。

llm_assessment.comment: A strong agent-security auditing framework that uses feedback-driven red-teaming to expose and localize prompt-injection vulnerabilities.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一项很强的智能体安全审计工作，通过反馈驱动的红队测试暴露并定位提示注入漏洞。
